ai_review.summary: Excellent‑sounding recording of a rare electric Deep Elem performance, delivering crystal‑clear audio.
ai_review.review: The fan notes that this tape sounds “so dang good,” highlighting the rarity and power of the electric Deep Elem Blues. Although only one set is present, the performance shines and the sound quality is praised as top‑notch, making it a must‑hear for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 5‑star review emphasizes both superb musical performance and high audio fidelity; lack of multiple reviews limits confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the sound as “so dang good” with no complaints, indicating clear and well‑balanced audio.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only one set is available; reviewer wishes for a second set but praises the existing material.
